test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which year were the Women Transforming India Awards started by NITI Aayog?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• NITI Aayog started the Women Transforming India Awards in **2016**__.
 
• The contest was launched to mark the celebration of **International Women’s Day**, 2016.
 
• It is an annual contest supported by the United Nations
